decision_rule: On 30 independent deal-cluster means, advance to disjoint confirmation only if mean candidate delta > 0 and lower approximate two-sided 95% t interval > 0; reject this direct treatment if upper interval < 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. This is a research screen, never acceptance or promotion. Record changed-play count separately.
goal: Measure fixed late-cardplay PIMC treatment against B0 on independent deals with all six hand contracts, three declarer seats, and three candidate seats
nearest_gate: Deal-clustered paired B0 gameplay evidence for cardplay challenger
next_on_failure: Preserve failure evidence, reconcile pod and only rerun from exact frozen task after correcting defect
next_on_success: Apply frozen descriptive rule; preserve negative/inconclusive evidence and decide whether independent confirmation has value
stop: source/task/deal mismatch, B0 failure, incomplete coverage, resource timeout, or illegal action
success: 540 exact positions, 1620 paired candidate games, no illegal actions, deal-clustered summary, result Hetzner hash/readback verified
treatment: PIMC override at one candidate seat only from play 22 onward, B0 otherwise
